creator: Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5) driving the owner's live Krita through the krita_mcp bridge
sourceMethod: New 320x224 sRGB RGBA/8 Krita document. The v2 shape designs were rescaled 1.24x about the new centre anchor and re-rendered with QPainter paths into named layers. Each state group holds a contact shadow, a 'Pillow paint' group (cream body; inherit-alpha clipped cool shade, core shadow, warm bounce light, window highlight and overlay fabric weave; made adds seam piping; unmade adds a folded corner and fold ridges) and a weighted warm taupe line layer. Shade layers softened with Krita's Gaussian blur. Saved with Krita's native KRA writer.
exportMethod: Krita exportImage of each state group alone at 320x224 (@2x, alpha on); @1x by `sips -z 112 160` from the @2x file.
inputs: app-momee/assets/references/concepts/*.png (white pillows with cool lavender-blue shade; viewed only)
boundsChange: v1/v2 canvas 128x96 @1x is replaced by 160x112 @1x for this size test. The Phaser pillow hit area (125x90 world units) is unchanged; a v3 sprite would overhang it slightly.
generativeModelUsed: No image-generation model. Shapes and colours were authored as code by the assistant.
reviewNotes: Candidate size test. Owner decides between the v2 size (≈ 106 u) and v3 (≈ 131 u, ≈ 1.5x the Boy's head width), and whether the hit area should grow with it.
